title: Guess who dataset_Chinese-Dutch mothers
descriptions: This file (Guess who_Chinese Dutch mothers) is supplementary material for the manuscript Color-evasiveness and white normativity in Chinese-Dutch families, which has been submitted to a peer-reviewed journal. Due to ethical concerns, all personal data has been removed from the dataset, but all of the important variables have been retained.
